item.title: Building the Navier–Stokes Equations
item.description: Meet each piece of fluid motion on its own, see why it alone falls short, then assemble the equation and run it live.

item.title: The History of Navier–Stokes
item.description: The partner to lesson 01: the same equation, built again — this time by history. Five discoveries, two strangers in the name, a 152-year paradox, and a million-dollar question still open.
